title: Report of the Committee Appointed to Consider the Advisability and to Estimate the Expense of Constructing Mr. Babbage’s Analytical Machine
authors: British Association for the Advancement of Science committee
version: Dublin meeting report, 1878, printed in the Report of the Forty-Eighth Meeting (London, 1879), pp. 92–102. Fourmilab transcription.
lineage: The committee’s later technical assessment and its published quotation from Babbage’s December 1839 letter to Arago. The British Library holds a manuscript draft at Add MS 37191, ff. 287–289; the draft itself was not inspected.

passages.note: Babbage first describes Jacquard’s loom cards and then explicitly credits the same card invention for giving calculation instructions to his Engine. The edition quotes a letter; it does not report an operating machine.
The committee describes the design as still requiring further detail to assess its feasibility and declines to recommend construction.

file.method: Copied from the Fourmilab transcription with HTML entities decoded and line breaks collapsed.
